description: Alterations to roof; rear dormer,  rooflights in the rear roof slope; three windows in side elevation; external alterations
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p><span style="font-size: inherit;">Notwithstanding the submitted drawings and documents, the roof lights hereby approved, to the rear roof slope and the proposed dormer, shall be conservation style roof lights (i.e: flush with the existing roofline/slope and shall not project above the plane of the roof), and shall be retained as such thereafter.</span></p><p></p><p><br></p><p></p><p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px 0px 10px;"><span data-teams="true" style="box-sizing: border-box;"></span></p>

The window(s) in the side elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

<p>The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.</p><p>Notwithstanding the submitted drawings and documentation, the windows of the proposed dormer, as well as the proposed side windows, must be timber framed.&nbsp;</p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
